item.description:
# Séance 0.2.11
- Quiet update checks when opening the app, returning to it, entering Settings and while active. Successful checks are limited to once every five minutes. - An available update badges Settings and the Updates header on Mac and iPhone. The Mac About tab also indicates availability. - Automatic discovery does not open the Mac installer. Downloads and installation remain your choice; manual checks and the automatic-check opt-out remain available. - Includes main's latest pin-animation and sidebar-control refinements.
iPhone build: 54. Existing pairing and chats should remain intact after updating.
